limitations: Google HTTPS endpoints redirected to an isolated local fixture server; no real Google sign-in or cloud upload.
Public historical fixtures and one disposable unfunded wallet generated by the app; no network transaction broadcast.
OAuth redirect behavior uses actual service tests; real Google sign-in and cloud storage remain unqualified. Fresh creation uses the compiled app against isolated local HTTPS fixtures.

chromeProductionAudit.scope: Bundle/package audit, not signed --release distribution gate.

firefoxRuntime.scope: Offline new-profile extension popup bootstrap and runtime CSP on local macOS152.0.4. Signed AMO installation/update, historical Firefox wallet upgrades and Linux CI remain separate gates.

locales.scope: Four shipped locales; mandatory read-only Astra ultra semantic and syllabification records retained for three new partial-recovery messages.

behavior: Multipart metadata is escaped, boundaries are unique, uploads require acknowledged nonempty file IDs, and deletion targets and awaits the actual escaped Drive file endpoint.
Drive listing follows every page and refuses incomplete inventories. All files, including standalone, orphaned, linked-child and legacy-metadata files, remain individually reachable.

OAuth uses the promise identity API with state/origin/path/error checks. Navigation targets only this extension popup, awaits the tab operation and carries encoded tokens. UI launchers reject stale callbacks and offer localized retry.

Export and fresh creation await each known upload acknowledgement, retain acknowledged child progress for retry, own their input/route lifetime and use canonical requested addresses for backup metadata.

Explicit primary-only import never claims the linked child was restored. Standalone Ethereum files validate without a Substrate-only address restriction. Active cloud flows retain their completion view and clear the OAuth route token when finished.

Password validation failures retain specific wording; invalid-file, worker, restore/storage and selection failures show generic localized retry. Existing encrypted records are preserved and completion follows storage/selection acknowledgement.
preservedDiagnostics: Actual service/export/inventory/launcher/create/partial-recovery regressions retain original failures. The first launcher test lacked IS_PRODUCTION, and first CreateGoogle test did not render the layout slot; corrected baselines distinguish these harness errors.

Browser v1 failed on the standalone external fixture package loader. v2/v3 assumed Ethereum JSON headers were canonical EVM addresses; actual compressed-public-key headers led to canonical metadata regressions and fixes.

Browser v4 reproduced App redirecting successful recovery into a token-bearing export screen; route-ownership regressions and token clearing fix that product defect. v5 reproduced standalone Ethereum validation incorrectly applying the Substrate address restriction.

Browser v6 proved restored original keys but locale navigation used Session.popup(hash), whose CDP HTTP request discarded the fragment. v7 explicitly navigates after opening and passes all 33 prior checks. Final v17 adds fresh creation and completion geometry on the final source.
First standalone-import regression leaked an unused mockResolvedValueOnce into later tests. Corrected v2 isolates the actual one-case failure and v3 adds the inert retry control baseline.
Initial full suite had the wrong focus token; corrected full suites pass. Lint v5 import ordering and typecheck v8/v9 union access errors are retained; final typecheck15 and lint13 pass.

Upgrade build v5 overlaps a type-guard edit and is excluded from final provenance. Final clean build v11 qualifies the browser run. Firefox build v3 overlaps the final heading edit and is excluded; clean v4 is used.

Browser v8 fresh creation reached confirmation but its selector counted both nested controls wrappers. The corrected v9 uses the inner wrapper. Inspection exposed real FlowStepLayout premature completion and hidden upload errors: the actual-layout baseline has three failures; b9604fe1 gates FinishForm on acknowledgement and keeps retry visible.

Browser v10 reproduces fixed256px completion links extending to pixel538 in a320px popup. Source9111e2ca wraps links; v12 reproduces a3px Akkadian200-percent heading overflow, fixed by inherited overflow-wrap:anywhere at970e1774. Finalv16 covers4locales,320/390widths and100/200-percent text, including all four link hit targets.

Independent raw v13 review identifies Finish overlapping the last social link despite social-center hit tests passing. Actual doubled-font v14 passes154checks but lacks footer separation; strengthened v15 reproduces the issue at en/320/200. Sourcee778e488 makes the content scroll inside a bounded flex area and keeps controls outside it. v16 adds row/footer separation and Finish hit-testing at every layout.

Browserv16 passes170checks with separated reachable footer, but CreateGoogle caches action translations during data initialization. Actual rendered locale-change baseline has1failure/8passes. Source64ca8fff stores locale keys and translates in computed buttonText;9focusedpasses. Finalv17 also asserts the actual footer text equals the current locale common.finish in every layout.

Browser v13 passes138checks with root-size stress only. App base16px means inherited labels did not double; v14 also changes the app font for test-only stress and asserts actual16/32px computed label sizes. Browser zoom and assistive technology remain separate acceptance gates.

Browser v11 stalled after restart with dozens of restored tabs from the disposable historical profile; current popup Runtime.evaluate stopped responding while the worker responded. The diagnostic and interrupted run are retained. Harnessv12-v17 closes stale copied-profile page targets before opening each new popup, preserves storage and forces the actual extension reload.

Firefox exact-warning audit initially rejected a changed artifact hash. Review proves the 41 warning sites and fingerprint are unchanged; soramitsuUI differs by one generated router import-binding byte. Runtime CSP remains enforced.
remainingGates: Final independent evidence review and integration.
Real Google sign-in, production OAuth identity/permissions and live Drive operations remain unqualified; all browser Google requests use isolated local HTTPS fixtures.
An upload whose remote outcome is unknown can leave an orphaned file; no exact-once remote-write guarantee is claimed. All returned inventory files remain reachable.
Physical devices, native mnemonic verification and full authentication journeys, Android completion, complete screen/accessibility matrix and final cross-platform release acceptance remain open.
Final-source historical upgrade/private-chain checks, historical signed Firefox upgrades, Linux CI, signing/store submission and publication remain separate release gates.
